title: Dominated convergence for pairings with a function integrable on a ball
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (w s : Rn N → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (ψ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ), IntegrableOn w (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R) volume → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ψ j) volume) → (∀ j y, |ψ j y| ≤ 1) → (∀ j y, y ∉ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → ψ j y = 0) → (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ ψ j y) atTop (𝓝 (s y))) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ y, w y * ψ j y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, w y * s y))
